common.codeImmutable: The code cannot be changed after creation.

jobTitle.title: Job titles
jobTitle.subtitle: Job titles (chức danh) with the statutory heavy / hazardous job category and default grade range.
jobTitle.hazardHint: Leave empty when the job is not on the statutory heavy / hazardous list (TT 11/2020/TT-BLĐTBXH). Changing it notifies People, Time & Attendance and Payroll.
jobTitle.jdHint: The document is uploaded in the Documents area; paste its ID.
jobTitle.gradeRangeHint: Pick both ends from one grade structure, lowest first, or leave both empty.
jobTitle.gradeRangeBoth: Pick both ends of the range or neither.
jobTitle.gradeRangeOrder: The lowest grade must rank at or below the highest.
jobTitle.occupationHint: National occupation classification code, used in statutory reports.

gradeStructure.title: Grade structures
gradeStructure.subtitle: Grade structures (ngạch) and their ranked grades (bậc). Pay scales and salary bands are managed in Payroll.

grade.title: Grades
grade.noPayNote: Grades carry no pay amounts (BR-CORE-021); salary bands per grade belong to Payroll.
grade.rankHint: Unique within the structure at any date; lower rank = lower grade.
grade.validFromHint: Leave empty to start today. Cannot be changed later.
grade.validToHint: Exclusive end date: the grade is valid until the day before. Leave empty for open-ended.
grade.validToAfterFrom: The end date must be after the start date.
grade.activeHint: An inactive grade is hidden from pickers and cannot be used in new default ranges.

errors.job-family-code-taken: A job family with this code already exists.
errors.job-title-code-taken: A job title with this code already exists.
errors.invalid-job-family: The job family does not exist or is inactive.
errors.unknown-hazardous-category: The heavy / hazardous category is not in the statutory list.
errors.unknown-document: The referenced document does not exist.
errors.invalid-grade-range: The default grade range must be two active grades of one structure, lowest first.
errors.grade-structure-code-taken: A grade structure with this code already exists.
errors.grade-code-taken: A grade with this code already exists in this structure.
errors.grade-rank-taken: This rank order is already used by another grade in an overlapping period.
errors.invalid-period: The end date must be after the start date.
